propositions: Pass-1 ladder entry and escalation rungs currently resolve to bare Anthropic model IDs regardless of configured provider, causing direct Anthropic calls in non-Anthropic workflows (split-brain at model_ladder[0] assignment and models_at_or_above lookup)
Model ladder must be expressed as class names (trivial, standard, frontier) and resolved through class config at runtime rather than hardcoded to provider-specific model IDs
models_at_or_above must map escalation rungs through class config so a Bedrock-configured run escalates to Bedrock models, not bare Anthropic IDs
MODEL_LADDER table and largest_window_tokens substring-matching behavior must remain unchanged to preserve context-window budgeting, with class resolution layered on top via post-lookup mapping

model_classes.resolve_model_string (already delivered by f844) must be wired at four call sites: config.resolve_model (lazy import to break cycle), production_batch_runner, code_review/batch_runner, and workflow/runners.py DefaultBatchRunner

resolve_model_string must preserve backward compatibility by returning bare names unchanged when no class config exists, maintaining byte-for-byte equivalence with current escalation and sizing behavior
